sources.entry: ClipTools - Clipboard utility set for quick copy, paste, and text cleanup tasks. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cliptools/id1619348240?platform=mac)

summary.name: ClipTools
summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar app offering clipboard history, saved clips, Smart Clips, date/time insertion, Lorem Ipsum, calculations, and text-case tools from a toolbox icon.
use_cases: Recalling earlier copied text from clipboard history
Storing reusable text snippets as saved clips or Smart Clips
Inserting the current date or time in a custom format
Doing quick calculations and pasting results into a document
Cleaning up or changing the case of selected text
summary.what_it_does: ClipTools keeps a recent history of copied plain text and rich text, and lets you paste, group paste, or save those clips from the menu bar. Smart Clips can embed special functions such as {clip:N}, {ask:}, {pick:}, {random:}, {calc:}, {case:}, and {web:} to build dynamic text. It can paste the date or time in custom Unicode formats, and type or select formulas to calculate and paste results. Selection tools include stats, case changes, headline case, URL encoding, HTML entity conversion, number-to-words, and a number stack with sum, mean, median and mode.
notable: Smart Clips with nested special functions such as {calc:}, {case:}, {sub:} and {web:}
Calculator that works on selected text or clipboard contents
Clip Manager window with search, hotkeys, and paste-and-close
Runs only from the menu bar with no Dock icon
caveats: Must be added to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility or it will not work
Many functions act at the text cursor or on selected text, so they need the cursor placed first
Text marked as passwords by apps is not added to clip history
